title: Register a model with Model Registry [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on Model Registry.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 Model Registry 的新實作。

cues.en: So, it's gonna be a super quick tutorial.
I just wanna show you how you can register a machinery model that you just built just like these two that we built in the section in this feature of SageMaker
cues.zh: 只想展示如何將剛建立的機器學習模型，例如本節這兩個，註冊到 SageMaker 的

cues.en: called the Model Registry.
Simply because at the exam, a question on the model registry might come up.
And so, doing this quick hands-on tutorial will help you remember what the model registry is about.
cues.zh: 簡短操作有助記住用途。

cues.en: Okay? So, there we go.
These are the two models that we just built.
cues.zh: 這是剛建立的兩個模型。

cues.en: The regression model and the classification model.
And now, let's imagine that we wanna register one of these two in the model registry, and I'll show you exactly where it is in SageMaker.
cues.zh: 假設想將其中一個註冊到登錄庫，也會展示它在 SageMaker 哪裡。

cues.en: Well, here's how we would do it.
Let's say that we wanna register the regression model.
So first, let's go inside our model.
We only build one version of this model, version V1.
cues.zh: 目前只建一個版本 V1。

cues.en: But just so you know as well, it's another question that might come up at the exam about model versioning.
cues.zh: 也補充，模型版本管理可能考。

cues.en: Well, just know that you can also create a new version by cloning either an existing version with configuration or creating a new version from scratch,
cues.zh: 可以複製既有版本與設定，或從頭建立新版本，

cues.en: which will give you several versions of your model, okay?
But now back to the model registry.
Well, let's go to our version V1 of our machinery model.
And here's how you can register your model in the model registry.
You click the three little dots here and there you go.
You click here, Add to Model Registry.
This will indeed add the model to the model registry, so that the studio users can catalog, review, and deploy the model in SageMaker Studio.
cues.zh: 會加入登錄庫，讓 Studio 使用者能編目、審閱、部署模型。

cues.en: And adding a machinery model to the model registry implies creating a model group.
cues.zh: 加入模型時，要建立模型群組。

cues.en: So, here we're gonna call our model group, canvas-Regression-Model.
And indeed a model group helps you organize and track multiple versions of the same model.
cues.zh: 群組有助組織、追蹤同模型的多版本。

cues.en: And you can only specify one model group per model version.
cues.zh: 每個模型版本只能指定一個群組。

cues.en: And after you register a version from this model, all subsequent versions are registered to the same model group, okay?
cues.zh: 註冊一個版本後，後續版本也都註冊到同群組。

cues.en: You see how model groups work.
It might as well come up at the exam.
That's why I prefer to show you this.
At least now you will smash any question on model registry and model groups, okay?
cues.zh: 現在遇到 Model Registry、Model groups 問題，就會了。

cues.en: So, no need to click Add here.
This was just to show you how to register the model, but as I said, now I'm gonna show you where to find the model registry in Amazon SageMaker AI.
cues.zh: 只是示範註冊，接著看看 Amazon SageMaker AI 哪裡有 Model Registry。

cues.en: Well, it's actually in the studio.
If we open the studio in a new tab, well, you will see that there is this feature called Models where it's actually located the model registry
cues.zh: 新分頁開 Studio，會看到 Models 功能，登錄庫在那裡，

cues.en: with the registered models in the model groups, okay?
cues.zh: 包含群組裡已註冊模型。

cues.en: So, let's open the studio and I'll just show you, and this is how we will end this tutorial.
cues.zh: 開 Studio 展示位置，然後結束教學。

cues.en: I'll show you exactly where this model registry is.
It's in this models feature here of the studio.
And there you go.
This is where you can indeed create, register, deploy, and manage models, okay?
cues.zh: 可建立、註冊、部署、管理模型。

cues.en: So, this is where you have your model groups.
We haven't created any, so here it's empty.
But this is how you could register a new model group exactly like what I just showed you in Canvas, okay?
cues.zh: 可像剛才 Canvas 示範一樣，註冊新群組。

cues.en: You can also click the register button here and there you go.
You give a name to your new model group here, a description if you want, and then you can select some models here to be included in the model group.
cues.zh: 命名新群組，可加描述，再選要包含的模型。

cues.en: All right, so there you go.
No need to go any further here.
This was just to show you what the model registry is, so that you can smash any model registry-related question at the exam.
cues.zh: 只是介紹 Model Registry，方便回答考題。

cues.en: So, now I'll see you in the next hands-on tutorial.
And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
